summary: One Metrocount piezo counter (243) on River Walk has run cleanly since June 2021 with one record per slot, no doubling and no direction problems. Almost every zero_outage fix sits on a rain or flood day, or a local closure, when every nearby counter dropped just as much, or in the dusk-to-dawn hours when this path is always empty; those fixes are restored. Short daytime one-direction dropouts in mid-2021 and on 2022-03-26 stay missing, as does 2024-05-30. The drop in level from Feb 2024 is real: at the same time site 206 went dark and 207 rose to match 205, which looks like the River Walk leg east of the junction closing.
